main_text.p: Perdidit: Futurum, ואבד Et perdidi te, Ezech.28.16. pro ואבד euphoniae causa. Hiph.Praeterit. והאביד Et perdet, Num.24.19. Fut. אבדר Perdam, Jerem.46.8. א radicali abjecto, & Cholem ex forma Kal, vel certe Chaldaica, assumpto. Chald. Infinit. להובדר Ad perden-dum, Dan.2.12. & in Aleph, להובדא v.24. Futurum, תהובד Perdes, v.24. יהובדון Perderent, v.18. in quibus א radicale mutatum in ו & ה characteristicum ex Hebraismo servatum, loco א. Hoph. Praeterit. הובד Perditum fuit, Dan.7.11.
אבר m. Perditio, Num.24.20. Psal.119.176. Quibusdam manet Particip. Kal. Est forma שרק Vitis generosa.
אבדה f. Res perdita, sive amissa, Levit.6.v.3. Construc-tum, לכל אבדת אחיך Omni rei amissae fratris tui, Deut.22.v.3.
אבדון m. Perditio, Perditionis locus, Interitus, Job 28.22. Prov.15.11.
אבדה f. Idem, Prov.27.20. quod legitur אבדו.
אבדן m. Idem: Constr. באבדן מולדתי In perditionem cognationis meae, Esth.8.6. juxta Aben Ezram.
אבדן m. Idem, Esth.9.5. quod juxta R.D.Kimchi possit esse Infinitum Pihel, cum ׳ paragogico, & Dagesch ejecto.

אבה Voluit, Acquievit: Construitur saepe cum Dat. & fere addita negatione: Praet. לא אבה לי Non acquievit mihi, Psalm.81.12. ולא אבו Et non voluerunt, Jes.28.12. cum א paragog. Fut. אל יאבא Ne acquiescito, Prov.1.10. ubi prima radicalis abjecta, & tertia in א mutata est.

אב m. Pater, à propensa Voluntate erga liberos, quasi Benevolus dictus: Item Author, Inventor primus, Gen.4.v.20. Doctor, 2.Reg.2.12. id est, רבי juxta paraphrasten Chaldaeum: Socer, affinitate pater, 1.Sam.24.12. Tri-buitur

page.notes: The Hebrew forms in the first entry (ואבד, והאביד, אבדר, להובדר, להובדא, תהובד, יהובדון, הובד) and the Hebrew in the entries that follow are copied as far as legible; the vowel points and the exact forms of several words are uncertain and may need checking against the scan at higher resolution. The large Hebrew headword אבה is in bold display type. The Hebrew running head is printed as שאב-style letters and is copied as אב. The word "Construc-tum" is hyphenated at the line end as printed.
